instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Record my AI's answers to any number of the rows of a method in one call, each with the rows it cites and the decision's evidence it rests on", and give it decision_id (The decision these answers are for); method (The id of the saved view that is the method); answers (One per row answered).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:record-method-answers and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Records answers to a method's rows for a decision: input { decision_id, method, answers: [{ row, answer, cites?, evidence_refs?

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: list (records:read); list-view (records:read); record:method-row (records:list); decision (records:read); decision-revision (records:read); decision-evidence (records:list); method-answer (records:read, records:list, records:write).
